function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, meaning some patients appear more than once in the data. This implies that we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient.", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate, we will double-count re-tested patients, which biases any aggregate measure (like response rate by site) because 24 patients were re-assayed.
